items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: I played with Lawrence Morrero, brother John

ctx.x: Well they were going to the Excelsior Band, Billy Moran.
You ever play with John Morrero or this other? Yeah, John, yeah.
I played with Lawrence Morrero, brother John, and then he was playing bass. He was playing bass, John. I was trying to get him to play bass now.
